description: Fixed-slot key-value table whose public kv_key_equals is also used internally with always-valid slots

bugs.trigger: kv_key_equals called directly (public API in include/kv.h) with slot >= KV_SLOTS (8): kv_table[slot] is read out of bounds (global array). The internal caller find_slot (via kv_find, kv_get) only passes slot < kv_used <= 8

lexer_expected: The lexer's candidate_entry_points for module 'kv' are the non-static functions with no caller in the module: kv_count, kv_load, kv_find, kv_get. kv_key_equals has an internal caller (find_slot) and is dropped, so no harness passes it an arbitrary slot and S05-1 is missed.
